title: Progressive canary with cost-SLO throttler and counterfactual smoke-run
author: Asha Patel
body:
Summary: Implements a progressive canary controller that enforces a cost-based SLO throttle and adds a counterfactual smoke-run mode to validate Prometheus/telemetry-driven rollback decisions without impacting live traffic. This PR wires the throttle into the rollout FSM, introduces a lightweight synthetic-replay harness for counterfactual validation, and tightens autoscaler interplay to avoid cascade oscillations when the throttle engages.

Motivation: Customers are increasingly deploying cost-sensitive model variants (smaller quantized models, cheaper vCPU fallbacks) alongside higher-cost models. We need rollouts that not only protect latency and correctness SLOs but also prevent runaway unit-cost spikes during progressive promotion. Existing controllers gate on latency/error metrics only and can overcommit GPU capacity; this introduces a new dimension — a cost SLO — that must be enforced during canary ramps and rehearse counterfactual decisions before committing.

Changes (high level):
- new controller: rollout/cost_throttle_controller.go — integrates cost-SLO checks into decision gates
- new module: rollout/smoke_replay.go — counterfactual smoke-run harness that replays a sampled traffic snapshot against candidate variant in isolation and computes delta metrics
- rollout/fsm.go — enrich FSM states with ThrottleRecommended/ThrottleEnforced and decision timestamps
- autoscale/coord.go — throttler-aware scale decision hints and backoff to prevent autoscaler <-> throttle oscillation
- ops/sim/cost-simplaybook.md — playbook and reproducible steps for oncall to simulate throttle scenarios
- integration tests: test/e2e/cost_throttle_smoke_test.go
- small changes to API surface: internal/api/rollout_v1.pb.go (minor proto addition: CostThrottleConfig)

Commits (summary):
- 1a2b3c4: initial cost throttle prototype and FSM hooks
- 9f8e7d6: smoke replay harness and sampled cohort capture
- 2b3c4d5: autoscaler hint integration and test scaffolding
- 7e6f5a4: add playbook and runbook for SRE
- a1b2c3d: docs: rollout console visualization for throttle state

Description: This PR introduces a first-class cost-SLO throttle that is evaluated alongside latency/error gates during progressive canaries and A/B promotions. The throttle is configurable per-rollout via CostThrottleConfig (budget: tokens-per-minute-equivalent; unit_cost_estimator: model profile or dynamic estimator). When the throttle is in Recommend state, the controller will slow ramp cadence; when Enforced, the controller pauses promotion and can trigger an automated rollback if counterfactual smoke-run shows regressions or cost spikes beyond budget.

Counterfactual smoke-run: to avoid noisy decisions based on partial telemetry, we added a deterministic replay harness. The controller can issue a dry-run against a 5% sampled cohort captured as a prefix-snapshot; the replay runs in a sandbox path (no responses sent to users) and populates the same metric pipeline with a synthetic tag (replay=true). The decision engine then compares live vs replay deltas to detect regressions and cost divergence.

Safety model:
- Default throttle budgets are conservative and opt-in per-namespace.
- Throttle enforcement requires agreement of two signals: cost > budget AND counterfactual delta confirms cost spike or quality regression.
- Human-in-the-loop: by default first enforcement only surfaces Recommend and pauses with a manual approval timeout (configurable).
- Autoscaler interplay: autoscaler receives a hint to not aggressively scale up when throttle is active; conversely, if autoscaler detects available headroom, the throttle can temporarily relax if quality signals are stable.

Files changed (high level):
- rollout/cost_throttle_controller.go (new): core throttle logic and integration with rollout FSM
- rollout/smoke_replay.go (new): replay pipeline and sampling
- rollout/fsm.go (mod): new states and decision metadata
- autoscale/coord.go (mod): hinting API with exponential backoff
- test/e2e/cost_throttle_smoke_test.go (new): end-to-end validation with local prometheus snapshot
- ops/sim/cost-simplaybook.md (new): step-by-step simulation and runbook
- docs/console/rollout-throttle.md (new): UI wireframe and guidance
- internal/api/rollout_v1.proto (mod): CostThrottleConfig proto
- internal/api/rollout_v1.pb.go (gen): small generated file snippet

Review thread (abridged):
- Miguel Santos (reviewer) on 2026-02-19: "Nice design. Two immediate asks: 1) make sure the cost estimator can be overridden per-tenant; 2) add a short-circuit for tiny canaries (<0.5% traffic) to avoid unnecessary replays."
Author (Asha) on 2026-02-19: "Agree on tenant override — added CostEstimatorRef in proto and config. For tiny canaries we now skip replay and only surface Recommend."
- Leah Bernstein (reviewer) on 2026-02-20: "Unit tests look good but the e2e flakes on CI — observed a race when sampling snapshots while the cohort rotates."
Author on 2026-02-21: "Fixed sampling lock and added deterministic seeding to replay harness. Pushed followup commit 2b3c4d5."
- Omar Khan (reviewer) on 2026-02-22: "Concern: autoscaler hint could cause slower scale ups that harm latency. Can we provide an override policy for latency-critical routes?"
Author on 2026-02-22: "Added per-route override and a policy annotation 'cost_throttle: allow-latency-critical' — defaults to off. Documented in ops playbook."
- Miguel (requested change) on 2026-02-23: "Please add a small benchmark showing cost estimator perf at 10k QPS."
Author on 2026-02-24: "Added microbench in test/e2e and results in PR description. Median latency 1.8ms for estimator at 10k QPS on dev machine; CPU < 2 cores equivalent."

CI and validation:
- Unit tests: 234 passed
- Integration: initial run flaky (sampling race) — rerun after fix passed
- Lint: go vet + staticcheck passed
- E2E: passed in this run with synthetic Prometheus snapshot
- Benchmark: cost estimator microbench added and included in CI smoke step

Merge notes:
- Squash merge after approval.
- Tagged release: rollout-controller v0.29.0 (internal)
- Change log entry: "Add cost-SLO throttle for progressive canaries; counterfactual smoke-replay and autoscaler coordination."

Operational playbook summary (ops/sim/cost-simplaybook.md):
- How to force a counterfactual smoke-run against a cohort snapshot
- How to interpret ThrottleRecommended vs ThrottleEnforced in Console
- Steps to manually approve/resume a paused rollout
- How to simulate autoscaler hinting and recover from oscillations

Rollout console: small UI addition shows throttle state inline with canary progress bars and provides one-click replay and approve actions.

Backwards compatibility and migration:
- CostThrottleConfig is optional; controllers without config behave like before.
- For clusters that do not opt-in, no replay or throttle is activated.
- Proto change is additive.

Release notes:
- Adds a configurable cost throttle that can recommend or enforce pauses on progressive canaries when unit cost exceeds configured budgets; includes counterfactual replay to reduce false positives.
- Adds autoscaler hinting to avoid scale/throttle oscillation.
- New ops playbook and console UI for visibility.

Follow-ups (planned):
- ENG-2401: automated tuning of throttle budget per-tenant based on historical unit cost
- ENG-2415: extend counterfactual replay to include synthetic adversarial prompts for robustness tests
- PM-900: UI for cross-rollout cost budgeting

Acknowledgements: design review by Miguel, Leah, Omar; implementation help from infra-team (Jin Wu) and SRE (Rina Gomez).
